description_en: Migrates an instance to a different zone
description_zh: 该接口用于迁移RDS实例的可用区
kebab_example: aliyun rds migrate-connection-to-other-zone --db-instance-id rm-bp1oypo6ky19y0000 --connection-string rm-bp1oypo6ky19y0000 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-i --region cn-hangzhou
name: MigrateConnectionToOtherZone

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。可通过DescribeDBInstances接口查询获取
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The endpoint of the instance. The endpoint is specified when you create the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例连接地址，创建时指定，用于生成连接串使用
parameters.name: connection_string
